description: Register a consequential action for human approval BEFORE performing it. Returns a request id. The action is NOT executed by this server; status 'approved' does NOT authorize anything by itself. Right before acting, call consume_approval with the same id and the exact action text; proceed only on ok:true. Anything else means no (fail closed).

action.description: Precise description of the action you intend to take, e.g. 'send email to alice@example.com with subject X'

reason.description: Why this action is needed right now

requested_by.description: Identifier of the requesting agent or workflow

ttl_seconds.description: How long the request stays pending before it expires (default 1 hour)

name: request_approval
